key_insight: AlgoRAG combines retrieval-augmented generation with TCS-specific indexing and re-ranking to deliver accurate, pedagogically useful explanations for abstract algorithm and complexity theory problems.
engineering_relevance: The paper shows that domain-tuned RAG can support scalable, on-demand tutoring for theory-heavy CS education where precise proofs and notation matter.
method: Built a curated knowledge base from textbooks, lecture slides, practice problems, proof templates, and worksheets.
Added mathematical entity recognition, notation-aware retrieval, and pedagogical re-ranking to improve answer quality.
Evaluated on 179 exam-style questions across core TCS topics.
evidence_signal: Across 179 curated questions, AlgoRAG reported 100% success, 38.0 s mean response time, zero BLEU-4, ROUGE-1 F1 of 0.0963, ROUGE-L F1 of 0.0683, and pedagogical quality of 0.7620.
watch_item: The zero BLEU-4 scores highlight that standard n-gram metrics can understate proof quality, so evaluation should include human or reasoning-sensitive measures.
paper_title: AlgoRAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Theoretical Computer Science Education -- A Comprehensive Evaluation Framework for Algorithm Analysis and Complexity Theory
